I replied to Marcus in his direct message to confirm that Dock 27 is now his dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Driftwood project.

The workspace's knowledge base (gbrain) had already saved his message as a fact, with Marcus as the source and this DM as where it came from. Only Marcus can see it. I didn't save a second copy because I couldn't tell who that copy would be visible to. Nothing else was needed, and I didn't share this with any channel or other member.
